changesApplied.changeMade: Created complete analytics router with 5 endpoints: GET /analytics/templates, GET /analytics/trends, GET /analytics/improvement-roadmap, GET /analytics/api-keys, GET /analytics/projects
changesApplied.reason: Frontend Dashboard UI (DevelopmentProgressDashboard and LearningView) calls these endpoints to display activity execution data. Without this router, all /analytics/* requests return 404, breaking the dashboard display.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero blast radius - new file, no existing code modified. Adds read-only aggregation endpoints that query SurrealDB activity_executions table. No side effects on write paths.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added import and export for analytics_router
changesApplied.reason: Make analytics_router available for registration in FastAPI app.py. Follows existing pattern for all other routers.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Minimal blast radius - single import added to module exports. No changes to existing imports. Enables app.py to include analytics router.

changesApplied.reason: Mount /analytics/* endpoints into FastAPI application routing. Without registration, endpoints exist but are not accessible via HTTP. This completes the data flow: Dashboard → Analytics Router → SurrealDB.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - single line added among existing router registrations. No modification to other routers. Analytics endpoints now accessible at /analytics/* prefix.

dataFlowRestored.after: Dashboard UI → GET /analytics/* → Analytics Router → SurrealDB activity_executions → Aggregate → Return JSON → Render UI
dataFlowRestored.verification: Endpoints now return aggregated data from SurrealDB. Dashboard can display activity templates, trends, and improvement roadmap.

endpoints.purpose: Aggregate template statistics (execution counts, success rates, costs)
endpoints.query: SELECT template_id, count(), success_count, avg_cost, avg_duration FROM activity_executions GROUP BY template_id

endpoints.purpose: Time-series activity trends with configurable period and granularity
endpoints.query: SELECT * FROM activity_executions WHERE started_at >= $start_date, then bucket by time and aggregate

endpoints.purpose: Identify templates with low success rates or high costs needing optimization
endpoints.query: SELECT templates GROUP BY template_id HAVING count() >= min_executions, filter by success_rate and cost thresholds

componentAnnotations.reason: Aggregates activity_executions by template_id to show which templates are being used, their success rates, and resource costs. Essential for dashboard visibility into activity execution patterns.
Provides time-series data for dashboard charts showing activity execution volume, success rates, and costs over time. Supports multiple granularities (hour, day, week) and periods (1d, 7d, 30d, 90d).
Identifies templates that need optimization based on success rate and cost thresholds. Helps users prioritize template improvements for better efficiency.
